notablePrerequisites: Astral Cornucopia does not have summoning sickness and has at least two charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Lifecraft Awakening by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Astral Cornucopia and causing it to become a 0/0 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, attaching it to Astral Cornucopia.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.
